newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia gangs practice fight tactics on donkeys.
newsitem.headline: Colombia gangs practice fight tactics on donkeys.

text.p: Teenage gangsters in northern Colombia are practicing deadly street fighting techniques on defenceless donkeys and old horses, the newspaper El Espectador reported on Tuesday.
In a recent incident in the Caribbean port of Cartagena, a donkey died after being stabbed 15 times by juvenile delinquents, some as young as 10, the report said.
In separate attacks, a mule was doused with acid and lost all its hair, and a horse had to be put down after it was kicked and punched in the legs and belly.

Fabio Castellanos, head of the provincial environmental protection department, said at least 20 donkeys and horses had been killed in similar attacks in the last month. The newspaper did not report any arrests in connection with the incidents.
